retrievalProfile.description: A dual-panel layout featuring a monochrome group portrait in formal wear with a vibrant, airbrushed script overlaying the top frame.
triggerTerms: neon script over black and white photo

recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical composition divided into two horizontal panels. Both panels contain the same monochrome photograph of five men in formal tuxedos with ruffled shirts, laughing and gesturing. The top panel is overlaid with a large, diagonal, airbrushed script title in green and orange gradients.
coreVisualRelationships: Repetition of the group portrait across two horizontal frames
Contrast between monochrome photography and vibrant neon-style lettering
Dynamic interaction between the subjects' gestures and the script placement
Formal attire juxtaposed with casual, joyful expressions
coreInvariants: Diagonal script overlay on the upper half

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five men arranged horizontally, waist-up, filling the width of both panels.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, vibrant script title spanning the upper panel.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the bright script down to the repeated group portrait, following the diagonal lean of the subjects.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with the group and large-scale lettering.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-contrast monochrome base with highly saturated, luminous accent colors in the typography.
paletteRestrictions: Use only two-tone gradients for text

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script with long, sweeping ascenders and descenders
letterConstructionRules: Airbrushed soft edges creating a glow effect
Varying stroke weight to mimic hand-drawn calligraphy
characterSpecificRedesigns: The first letter is significantly oversized and serves as a frame element
Terminal strokes extend into long, horizontal flourishes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single dominant script paired with a very small, wide-tracked sans-serif for secondary metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the mid-century casual script energy
Best for replicating the specific airbrushed flourishes

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a vertical layout split into two equal horizontal panels. In each panel, place the same high-contrast black and white photograph of five men in 1970s tuxedos laughing. Add a thin black line separating the panels.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, diagonal cursive script across the top panel. Use a gradient from neon green at the top to soft orange at the bottom, with a soft airbrushed glow effect.

verificationChecks: Is the image split into two identical horizontal panels?
Does the script have a soft, airbrushed neon appearance?
Is the script tilted diagonally upwards?

adjustableVariables: Number of subjects in the photo
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible despite the gradient and glow.
Verify the split-screen line is perfectly horizontal.
Check that the subjects' expressions are joyful and candid.
Confirm the script spans nearly the entire width of the frame.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a [monochrome group portrait] + duplicate into [two horizontal panels] + overlay [diagonal airbrushed script] in [neon gradients].
